repair.diagnosis: The fixed sticky-promo bar overlays and blocks the fixed Add to Cart button
repair.evidenceSummary: Screenshot shows only the black Free shipping promo bar at the bottom with no visible Add to Cart button. Probes at mobile, small, and desktop show #add-to-cart inViewport but hitIsSelf=false with hitElement #sticky-promo; CSS gives .sticky-promo fixed bottom:0 height:84px z-index:20 while .add-to-cart is fixed bottom:16px height:52px z-index:10, so the promo covers the button.
repair.rationale: Raise the button 84px promo height plus 16px spacing above the promo so both elements remain visible and the button receives real pointer hits without removing or hiding either element.

parsed.rationale: Evidence confirms overlay: #add-to-cart inViewport but hitIsSelf=false hit by #sticky-promo due to z-index 10 vs 20 and bottom 16px vs promo 84px height. Fix to bottom:100px (84+16) lifts button above promo with spacing, preserving both elements. Verification shows interactive-usable@mobile/small/desktop and pointer-purchase-works resolved, no regressions, remaining failures are unrelated cart-total defects.

repair.diagnosis: Cart total uses a stale legacy unit price instead of the canonical catalog price for nova-sneaker
repair.evidenceSummary: Screenshot and catalog show product price $89.00 (priceMinor 8900), but probes show cart totalMinor 7900 after 1 item and 15800 after 2 items, i.e. 7900 per item instead of 8900/17800 derived from catalog
repair.rationale: Use product.priceMinor from window.CATALOG as the single source of truth for cart totals, without hardcoding the catalog value, so cart matches the displayed/catalog price

parsed.rationale: Fix correctly replaces stale LEGACY_CART_PRICE_MINOR (7900) with canonical product.priceMinor (8900) from window.CATALOG, matching displayed/catalog price. Evidence shows cart totals now 8900/17800, resolving both failing signals with no regressions and without hardcoding the value.
